message: Hi, my little one Tao is 4 and wants to try jiu jitsu. Do you have classes for that age?

Hi! Yes, we do have Kids Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu classes for 4-year-olds. It's a great age to start!
The kids program is structured and age-appropriate, so Tao would be with other kids around the same age. Would you like to book a free trial class to see if it's a good fit?
Yes, I’d love to book a free trial class for Tao! What time slots do you have available?
Perfect! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
Great, thanks Tester! And what's the best email to send the trial class details to?
You can send the details to tester.tundra@gmail.com.
Perfect! And can I get your phone number? Just so we can reach you if anything comes up with the class.
Great! And just to confirm, what's Tao's full name and date of birth?
Tao’s full name is Tao Tundra, and he was born on April 20, 2022.

Perfect! I have some spots available for Tao this week. Here are a few options:

Tuesday 7/8 at 5:35 PM
Wednesday 7/9 at 5:35 PM
Thursday 7/10 at 5:35 PM

Which works best for you?
Let's go with Tuesday 7/8 at 5:35 PM. Thank you!
Perfect! Tao is all set for his free trial class on Wednesday 7/8 at 5:35 PM. We'll send the details to tester.tundra@gmail.com. See you both then!
